name: session-weather
description: A pane with the session's weather: context fill and auto-compact point, the last turn, the 5-hour and weekly limits and this session's part of each, the cost, and a Haiku summary of what Claude is thinking

summaryLanguage.title: Thinking summary language
summaryLanguage.description: The language Haiku writes the thinking summary in, named as you would to a person: English, Vietnamese, Japanese… The pane's own labels stay in English, but for Vietnamese.

summaryGapSeconds.title: Seconds between summary requests
summaryGapSeconds.description: At most one Haiku request this often while a turn runs, from 5 to 120; a value outside that is held to it. Notes left without an update for three times this long get one.

compactSoonPercent.title: Compact soon at (% of the way to compaction)
compactSoonPercent.description: Where the forecast turns to Compact soon and a toast warns, in percent of the way to the auto-compact point, from 76 to 100; a value outside that is held to it, so Storm (from 75) keeps its band.
